title: Reviewer verdict (final JSON block of every review)

review_id.description: visual-reviewer: the id it was given (<phase>-visualA-r<N> or <phase>-visual-r<N>); the SubagentStop hook stores the verdict under it

captured_by.description: set by .claude/hooks/subagent_stop.py on stored visual verdicts; tools/review.py close requires it

shots_folder.description: set by the SubagentStop hook: the folder the reviewer opened every shot PNG from

bar.description: visual-reviewer: bar item -> pass | fail: reason

shots.description: visual-reviewer: shot name -> pass | fail: rubric items below the minimum and why

scores.description: visual-reviewer: every shot of the current shot set -> every kit.json visual.rubric item -> 1-5, or "n/a" only on stage-A ids for items outside visual.stage_a_items (docs/visual-pipeline.md section 3)

top_problems.description: visual-reviewer: the three biggest problems by visual impact, most important first

shot_set_version.description: version of docs/shots/shots.json the shots were rendered from

outcome.description: set by the main session after acting

captured_from.description: set by the SubagentStop hook: where the verdict was found

vs_previous.description: visual-reviewer: per shot better|same|worse vs the previous round, with why; says so explicitly when it reverses an earlier request
